workflow.description: Renders a complex answer as a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled CLI builds a single page (templates, SVG auto-layout, STE writing check). Also for explainer videos ("3b1b style video", "make a video", "做个视频", "讲成视频"): the same draft plus narration lines renders a narrated player page, optionally an MP4. Also for `/answer-me-with-html config` or settings (auto-open, always-on mode, default theme). Use proactively, without being asked, when the answer involves: 3+ interrelated concepts; a flow / protocol / architecture with branches or multiple actors; a comparison or trade-off across 3+ dimensions; a hierarchy (directories, modules, taxonomies); an evolution or phases; or the user says "explain how it works / I don’t get it / draw a diagram / explain this codebase / explain visually / 讲讲原理 / 没看懂 / 画个图 / 用 HTML 讲". Do not use for: short Q&A (clear in under ~150 words), commands to copy and run, pure code changes, or plain-text requests.

nodes.name: 主会话 · 非视频交付与验收
nodes.prompt_template: Perform semantic acceptance and brief delivery in this initiating Main conversation. Assess product_source against task using supplied text, or its declared path when text is omitted. For page_batch, assess every batch_products request, semantic_source and shared constraints. Reuse Host producer evidence for mechanical facts. Expand investigation only for a concrete omission, inconsistency or required visual check. Preserve valid content and scoped revisions; later feedback has no invented revision cap. Plain/update/config/cleanup use their supplied answer, guidance or result. Return accepted=true and concise newly authored semantic_result only after acceptance, using the original core-conclusion delivery style and disclosing actual non-strict STE outcomes. Relay actual cleanup/update notices without performing maintenance. Host records the accepted result and verified delivery.

nodes.name: 请求与输出类型
nodes.prompt_template:
Classify the supplied task in this current conversation. Use its already-visible [answer-me-with-html always-on] reminder, if any. An explicit page, video or independent-page request already establishes product intent. Infer behavior standard/always_on/excluded and route. Config/cleanup have separate no-page routes; updates use the original selected installation method. Preserve explicit empty config and invalid null/non-object handling; Host tools consume original task.config/task.clean.

Standard: page triggers are three related concepts; flows, protocols or architecture (including linear); three-dimensional comparisons; hierarchy or time evolution; explicit diagrams, visual explanations or principles. Exclude plain-text requests, copy/run commands, pure code changes and short ordinary Q&A.
Always-on: any conclusion, summary, proposal, comparison, review or explanation requires a page, however brief. Only casual chat, one or two sentences without a conclusion, pure command output, explicit plain text, maintenance routes omit pages. Standard short-answer/pure-code exclusions do not apply. Small always-on pages use 2–4 panels and --no-open.

Video requires explicit intent; MP4 and patch re-export require explicit export intent. MP4 itself requests video, never page. For video creation/revision with task.mp4=true normalize to video_mp4/video_patch_mp4; never infer MP4 without intent.
Products: infer new render_selection destination={path} or {}, panel={value} or {} (creation uses {}), opening inherit/open/no_open and overrides. Host binds existing structured fields and derives authority/execution fields. Product options/selection={}; non-products render_selection=null. Keep maintenance selection/options on their routes. Return only new decisions.

Choose page_batch for independently deliverable new pages; comparisons or multiple panels of one page stay page. Batch render_selection=null, options/selection={}. Host binds structured task.pages: omit pages. Otherwise infer pages in request order with complete page-specific requests and optional render_selection. Every batch returns batch_context containing only common terminology/style/language/content requirements, or empty string if none; omit page-specific requests and Main handoff/delivery instructions. Preserve explicit original batch_context exactly; report conflicting per-page declarations instead of overwriting. Host combines common context with each page and retains the complete task for final acceptance. Non-batch routes omit batch_context; single-product/maintenance routes omit pages.
If task.video_asset is supplied, choose video_reuse, behavior=standard, options={}, selection={}, render_selection=null. The Host exports that completed player and preserves its supplied manuscript/audio. Do not select new production or rewrite supplied assets.

nodes.name: Main · 文本撰写与验收
nodes.prompt_template: Answer this explicitly plain-text request in the initiating Main. Write and check the requested text here; deliver it directly through this same Main acceptance. If task.text_artifact is supplied, write the complete text to that workspace-relative path and return a brief delivery address as semantic_result. Otherwise return the complete plain answer as semantic_result. For a video manuscript requested as text only, inherit the original format, narration and STE rules from the supplied references; use the pinned original CLI help/lint if needed, without invoking video, render, TTS or export. Review the requested explanations and causal relationships while composing. Return accepted=true and newly authored semantic_result only after that check. Follow the requested text-only boundary.

nodes.name: Human approval
nodes.prompt_template: Approve deleting exactly the files in this sealed dry-run preview, with its displayed count, size and retention parameters? Configuration is preserved. Any inventory change requires a new preview and approval.

nodes.name: HTML · 新建页面
nodes.prompt_template: First plan 3–8 question panels for the requested explanation; each panel answers one subquestion. Use 2–4 panels for a small always-on answer, without padding. Choose built-in components by information shape, then write the extended Markdown draft in the user's language. Use the declared workflow-assets/host-adapter/format-reference.md resource and task settings for layout, language, columns, spans, bare panels and metadata. Put the core conclusion first. Follow the original STE rules and preserve valid content. Submit the draft once through worker_task.production_interface (inside your assigned page for a batch), placing the exact manuscript text in its stdin field. The Host-supplied literal executable and arguments invoke the original generation entry from the assigned workspace; the entry commits the source after admission. After this original renderer invocation, read its exact component/STE line diagnostics. Repair the identified component line using the supplied correct example, or rewrite the identified STE line, then render the corrected draft through this same entry in this context until writing_check.complete is true. Preserve the original two STE revision rounds independently of component repairs; report strict exhaustion or a mechanical failure explicitly. Return only a concise newly authored conclusion after finished production. Use run_workspace_program for the supplied production_interface and continue_workspace_command only if that invocation returns a running session. The supplied worker_task.help_interface provides original component help, list, version and stdin lint commands when needed.

nodes.name: 视频 · 写稿与原版配音、画面生成
nodes.prompt_template:
Create the requested video manuscript. Follow video-reference.md and the original component/STE grammar in format-reference.md. Write concise conversational narration in the user's language, with natural sentence flow and clear scene transitions. Treat [Name] as part of the spoken sentence: the original renderer speaks that name. Use it only when useful for focus, matched exactly to a scene node. Preserve every requested relationship. For a requested why/how, explain the cause and its result in short natural sentences, rather than only naming a benefit. Respect the requested duration and check the actual duration reported by the original CLI.

Submit the manuscript as stdin to the exact worker_task.production_interface with run_workspace_program. Its original CLI reports component errors and STE diagnostics. Repair through that same interface in this context until writing_check.complete is true; preserve the original two STE revision rounds and surface strict exhaustion or mechanical failure. Use worker_task.help_interface for unresolved original component grammar. Use continue_workspace_command only if production returns a running session. The original provider makes narration and scene HTML; explicit MP4 export belongs to Host.

When review_feedback is present, change only the concrete reported defects in its current product_source, preserving valid material and the same original production boundaries. Finish production here and return only a concise conclusion. Host verifies mechanical results and the initiating Main accepts the finished video.
